question: getting 429 even though im way under my limit, whats going on
supported_answer: Acceleration limits. Beyond the published per-minute limits, a sharp increase in an organization's usage can produce 429s even while under the stated rate limit. The documented remedy is to ramp traffic gradually and maintain consistent usage.

evidence.quote: You might also encounter 429 errors because of acceleration limits on the API if your organization has a sharp increase in usage.

atomic_claims: 429 errors can come from acceleration limits, not only from the published rate limits
acceleration limits trigger on a sharp increase in organization usage
reasoning_type: identifying a documented second cause behind one status code
ambiguity_notes: Question said 'either' provider; answered from Anthropic where acceleration limits are documented by name.
verifier_notes: This is the case the asker's premise ('way under my limit') is actually about: the corpus documents a 429 path that does not require exceeding the stated limit.

question: overloaded_error keeps happening at peak hours. is that a 429 or a 529
supported_answer: 529. overloaded_error is the 529 status: the API is temporarily overloaded, which occurs under high traffic across all users. A 429 is a different situation — it can appear from acceleration limits when your own organization ramps usage sharply.

evidence.quote:
529 errors can occur when the API experiences high traffic across all users.

    In rare cases, if your organization has a sharp increase in usage, you might see 429 errors because of acceleration limits on the API.

atomic_claims: 529 occurs under high traffic across all users
429 from acceleration limits is a distinct case caused by a sharp increase in your own usage
